jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(7)(K) inventory: Strafford School District, a town school district in the White River Valley Supervisory Union (member town: Strafford). Operates PK-8; tuitions grades 9-12 by school choice.
White River Valley Supervisory Union (official site).

board.post_note: Strafford SD: five directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423(a)-(b), elected by Australian ballot. Two seats are held (see the source note).

sources.note: Newton School 2025-2026 Family/Student Handbook (official district document): the five-member board -- Root (Chair), Donaldson (Clerk), Siddiqi (Clerk), Lopez, Ray. The Town of Strafford 2024 Annual Report officers list publishes Root's term expiring March 2027 and Donaldson's and Ray's expiring March 2026. HELD: Donaldson and Ray -- their published terms expired at the March 3, 2026 election and no official return was fetched (Herald reports, leads only, say both stood again and remain seated; resolving document: the March 3, 2026 district return or the 2026-27 handbook). Lopez's and Siddiqi's ends are published in no fetched official document (Herald-reported 2028/2027 are leads) -- minted with NO ends. (Frame correction recorded in the research: Strafford does NOT designate a high school; the board voted to keep full school choice.)
